1: The baselines are weak and expensive. Try 8 new hypotheses on money flow and sentiment: price-volume divergence, 52-week-high anchoring, 'lottery' stocks (skew), Amihud, overnight gaps.
2: pv_divergence and near_high lead and are almost uncorrelated -> cross them. Mutate windows to test robustness. Amihud and overnight have negative IC -> flip the sign.
3: Gen 2: decay_linear hit NaN and was rejected -> switch to ts_mean. pv_div with a 20-day window is much weaker = parameter-sensitive. Smooth signals to cut turnover, combine 3 signal sources.
4: First alpha to beat the basket after fees (high_dist_slow). But the elite are all near_high variants (correlation 0.7–0.95) -> look for orthogonal signals: MAX effect, low beta, up-day volume.
5: low_beta has a strongly negative IC (t = -2.65) -> flip it to high beta (a cyclical bet, be careful). up_volume_share is orthogonal (corr 0.27) -> add it to the leading alpha.
6: 44 alphas tried, so the risk of a lucky hit is growing -> robustness checks: 120-day beta still gives t = 3.46; the ablation dropping skew lowers t from 3.79 to 3.30, so skew really contributes.
7: beta_high_div leads but turnover is 45x/year -> smooth the fast component. Add intraday momentum (tug of war). The t-stat cannot beat 3.97: a sign of saturation.
8: Increase the weight of the slow components. The improvement from 3.97 to 4.07 (< 0.1) makes 2 generations without progress -> stop the search.
